4. First-aid measures
Eye contact: rinse with plenty of water for at least 15 minutes and seek medical advice.
Skin contact: remove contaminated clothing and wash the skin with soap and water.
Inhalation: move the person into fresh air and keep them at rest.
Ingestion: rinse the mouth and do not induce vomiting.
5. Fire-fighting measures
Vapours are heavier than air and may travel to a source of ignition and flash back. Cool closed containers exposed to fire with water spray.
Suitable extinguishing media
Alcohol-resistant foam.
Carbon dioxide or dry powder for small fires.
Water spray for cooling containers only.
